dict.string: openclicky listens while you hold Control-Option so you can talk to it.
openclicky turns what you say into text on this Mac.
openclicky can find and save files on your Desktop when you ask.
openclicky can find and save files in Documents when you ask.
openclicky can find and save files in Downloads when you ask.
openclicky uses an app's own scripting to do things you ask for.
